answer: Let trust grow like a pearl: each identity starts with zero standing and earns one thin layer per epoch of verified, useful work, recorded in a crystal-clear public ledger. Standing decays fast if the identity goes idle, and high-value jobs open only above a high ledge of accumulated layers. An honest agent climbs naturally by doing its normal work, at no extra cost. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 work histories alive every epoch, since one idle epoch slides each fake back down, so the attack costs 1,000 real workstreams, forever, not one fee.
